---
title: "Cold Start"
description: "A software-craft blog about distributed systems, storage engines, and the quiet engineering that keeps production alive."
---

Cold Start is a blog about the unglamorous half of software: the storage
engines, replication protocols, queues, and recovery procedures that decide
whether your product is up at 3 a.m. or not.

No hot takes about frameworks. No predictions about the next paradigm. Just
careful notes on systems that have to survive contact with reality — written
by people who carry the pager.

New posts roughly every other week. Subscribe via [RSS](/index.xml).
